Metadata.title: Offroad Capital | Private Credit Origination
Metadata.description: Offroad Capital structures company financing needs into private credit opportunities and connects them with investors whose mandates are aligned with each transaction.

Home.eyebrow: AI-DRIVEN ORIGINATION PLATFORM FOR PRIVATE CREDIT
Home.heroBody: Borrower information becomes a structured private credit opportunity in minutes. Companies reach the market prepared. Investors access new deal flow aligned with their mandates, ready to assess.
Home.heroSignature: Structured for the market. Matched to the mandate.
Home.heroBrandLead: The best opportunities are rarely on the obvious path.
Home.heroValueSimpleMessage: Companies upload their documents and answer only what is necessary.
Home.heroValueOrganizedMessage: Financial information is reconciled, standardized and presented clearly.
Home.heroValueStructuredMessage: Capital needs become transactions prepared for the market.
Home.heroValueEfficientMessage: Investors receive consistent information and spend less time reconstructing each opportunity.
Home.heroValueTargetedMessage: Each transaction reaches investors with a more aligned mandate, ticket and profile.
Home.heroSupport: Better-prepared companies. More efficient originators. Better-aligned opportunities for investment managers.
Home.heroNote: Credit technology and intelligence to prepare, analyze, and connect opportunities. Credit decisions and transaction execution remain with the parties.
Home.flowTitle: FROM CAPITAL NEED TO PRIVATE CREDIT OPPORTUNITY
Home.flowCompanyBody: A solid business. A credible project. A financing need not yet structured for private credit.
Home.flowBenefitFlow: New deal flow beyond existing networks
Home.flowInvestorBody: Less time reconstructing the case. More time underwriting what fits.
Home.filmTitle: An opportunity progresses from request to the right capital.
Home.filmStructuredTitle: The capital need takes institutional form.
Home.filmStructuredBody: The company and originator organize context, documents, and objectives in one flow.
Home.filmVisibleBody: Reconciled metrics preserve source, version, period, and review to accelerate analysis.
Home.filmMatchedBody: Cash flow, collateral, and market conditions inform a defensible structure.
Home.filmFundedBody: Investment managers receive the alignment rationale and constraints before any introduction.
Home.productTitle: Less rework at origination. More clarity in the decision.
Home.productIntakeTitle: One shared foundation for the transaction.
Home.productIntakeBody: The company and originator work from the same information set, with reconciled documents and facts connected to source.
Home.productAnalysisTitle: A more objective initial credit view.
Home.productAnalysisBody: Capacity, risks, and diligence items appear before the opportunity is presented to capital providers.
Home.productAgentTitle: Governance to move forward with control.
Home.productAgentBody: Automation reduces operational work; authority, information sharing, and material decisions remain under human control.
Home.previewDisclaimer: Illustrative data only; not a real offer or recommendation.
Home.statementTitle: Capital exists. The challenge is making the opportunity clear, comparable, and analyzable.
Home.statementBody: Strong companies remain off the radar because their data arrives fragmented, their capital need is not calibrated, and their story has not yet been translated into the language of a credit committee.
Home.statementAside: Offroad organizes evidence, determines what the business can support, proposes defensible structures, and opens the right doors - with human control over every material decision.
Home.journeyTitle: Each stage removes friction from the process.
Home.journeyStructuredBody: The company presents its capital need and documents once, through a guided flow.
Home.journeyVisibleBody: The originator turns fragmented information into a consistent, comparable, and analyzable opportunity.
Home.journeyMatchedBody: The structure is assessed against mandates and investment criteria, with explicit alignment and constraints.
Home.journeyFundedBody: The company, originator, and investment manager authorize a qualified introduction with enough context for the next decision.
Home.audienceTitle: One coordinated flow. Three objective gains.
Home.companyAudienceTitle: Reach a broader capital universe with a better-prepared transaction.
Home.companyAudienceBody: Turn fragmented documents and plans into a structured credit case calibrated to repayment capacity and ready for qualified conversations.
Home.originatorAudienceTitle: Originate with greater speed, consistency, and reach.
Home.originatorAudienceBody: Standardize preparation and initial analysis, reduce rework, and connect your company relationship to a broader capital-provider universe.
Home.capitalAudienceTitle: Review opportunities filtered by your mandate.
Home.capitalAudienceBody: Receive structured transactions with traceable evidence, explicit constraints, and an alignment rationale before the introduction.
Home.trustTitle: Evidence, governance, and authorization at every stage.
Home.trustEvidenceBody: Every material fact preserves its document, version, page, period, unit, confidence, and review state.
Home.trustMathBody: AI interprets and drafts. Financial calculations are versioned, reproducible, and testable.
Home.trustControlBody: No silent changes. No information sharing without prior review, applicable authority, and explicit approval.
Home.trustDataBody: Organization-level data segregation, private storage, and telemetry without documents, names, or financial information.
Home.boundaryTitle: We prepare the opportunity and create the introduction. The parties execute the transaction.
Home.boundaryBody: Confirmatory diligence, final underwriting, legal negotiation, collateral perfection, approval, funding, and servicing remain with the participants and qualified partners.
Home.boundaryProductValue: Information organization, evidence, reconciliation, capacity, structure, materials, mandate alignment, and qualified introduction.
Home.boundaryPartiesValue: Final diligence, binding terms, documentation, closing, funding, and credit management.
Home.ctaKicker: Three entry points. One more efficient market.
Home.ctaTitle: What is your role in the private credit market?
Home.ctaBody: Present a capital need, expand your origination capacity, or register your mandate criteria. Offroad organizes the right path for every participant.
Home.footerCategory: AI-Driven Private Credit Origination & Market Access
Home.footerNotice: Public launch is subject to legal, regulatory, trademark, and digital clearance.

Auth.title: Access the Offroad Capital platform.
Auth.body: An institutional environment for companies, authorized advisors, funds, and investment managers. Use your email to access your organization's dedicated area.
Auth.loginBody: Use the email and password associated with your organization.
Auth.noAccount: Do not have an account yet?
Auth.resetComplete: Password updated. You can now log in.
Auth.error: We could not complete access. Review the details or try again.
Auth.providerMissing: The identity environment is not configured yet.
Auth.security: Restricted access, organization-level data segregation, and permissioned information sharing.
Auth.errorTitle: The link could not be confirmed
Auth.errorBody: It may have expired or already been used. Request a new access link.

Signup.contextBody: Companies gain structured access to private credit beyond traditional channels. Advisors originate more consistently. Investors receive opportunities aligned with their mandates.
Signup.assurance: Your profile shapes the experience. Authority, mandates, and data access remain subject to verification.
Signup.title: How do you participate in the market?
Signup.body: Choose the profile that best represents your role. You can complete the institutional information after confirming your email.
Signup.companyBody: I want to present and structure a capital need.
Signup.originatorBody: I want to register opportunities on behalf of advised companies.
Signup.providerBody: I want to register funds and mandates to receive aligned opportunities.
Signup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters and numbers.
Signup.verificationNotice: * We will send a verification code to the email provided.
Signup.legal: By continuing, you confirm that the information is accurate and that you are authorized to represent the organization indicated.
Signup.error: We could not create the account. Review the details or try again.
Signup.providerMissing: The identity environment has not been configured yet.
Signup.verifyContextBody: Email verification is the first security layer before the institutional environment is created.
Signup.verifyBody: We sent a temporary code to the email provided. It expires in 10 minutes.
Signup.resent: A new code has been sent.
Signup.codeError: The code is invalid or expired. Review the six digits or request another.
Signup.resendError: We could not resend yet. Wait one minute and try again.

Recovery.contextBody: Resetting a password requires a temporary code sent to the email already connected to the account.
Recovery.assurance: Offroad will never request your password or verification code by phone or direct message.
Recovery.title: Receive a recovery code
Recovery.body: Enter the email for your account. If it is registered, you will receive the next instructions.
Recovery.error: We could not start recovery. Review the email or try again.
Recovery.verifyContextBody: The code is temporary and can only be used once to reset the password.
Recovery.verifyBody: Use the code sent to the email provided.
Recovery.codeError: The code is invalid or expired. Request a new code.
Recovery.updateContextBody: Choose a unique password for your Offroad Capital account.
Recovery.updateBody: The new password immediately replaces the previous one.
Recovery.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters and numbers.
Recovery.passwordError: Passwords must match and contain at least 10 characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, and numbers.

Onboarding.title: Prepare your Offroad environment.
Onboarding.body: We save every step so you can resume later. Sensitive information remains restricted to your organization.
Onboarding.identifierNote: We retain only a cryptographic fingerprint and the last four characters.
Onboarding.purposeSummary: What does the company intend to finance?
Onboarding.strategicImportance: Why is this important to the business?
Onboarding.expectedOutcome: What outcome should the plan generate?
Onboarding.uploadBody: Upload financial statements, trial balances, cash flow, debt schedules, projections, institutional materials, CIM, or credit memo.
Onboarding.uploadCategories: PDF, CSV, XLSX, or DOCX. Up to 50 MB per file.
Onboarding.uploadError: One or more files could not be uploaded. Check the format, size, and connection.
Onboarding.documentsRequired: Upload at least one document before continuing to review.
Onboarding.multipleFundsNote: You can add more funds, vehicles, and strategies after the environment is active.
Onboarding.mandateReviewBody: Declared and versioned criteria for opportunity qualification.
Onboarding.documentsReviewBody: Files remain private and will be validated before processing.
Onboarding.reviewNoticeProvider: Once active, the criteria guide opportunity qualification. Offroad does not presume interest or a credit decision.
Onboarding.reviewNoticeOriginating: Once submitted, the need enters initial preparation. This is not an approval, offer, or guarantee of funding.
Onboarding.error: We could not save this step. Review the fields and try again.

App.welcomeComplete: Registration complete. Your institutional environment is ready.
App.companyWelcome: Your capital need, prepared for the market.

App.originatorWelcome: More consistency from source to opportunity.
App.originatorWelcomeBody: Manage companies, authorizations, and opportunities in one flow, with less rework during preparation.
App.providerWelcomeBody: Keep funds, criteria, and contacts current to receive only transactions qualified against the declared mandate.
App.welcomeBody: Structure financing needs, gather evidence, and move each opportunity through clearly defined analysis and approval stages.
App.emptyFundBody: The mandate turns investment criteria into clear origination filters.
App.routingContactsBody: The right contact reduces unnecessary forwarding and preserves introduction quality.
App.emptyBody: Initial registration organizes the capital need. Financial capacity and recommendation remain independent from the requested amount.
App.newTitle: Describe what the company needs. The analysis determines what the business can support.
App.requestNote: The desired amount is not presented as financeable capacity until deterministic analysis is complete.
App.formError: We could not create the opportunity. Check the fields or a possible duplicate.
